title: JPG file with CMYK colorspace fails importing or loading from buffer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono
- Happy to test in 4.6 once it hits the Manjaro repos

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono unknown - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 08 Jan 2026 10:03:06 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 31.05 GiB memory

### Issue description

Echoing closed issue https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/45523, I am using jpg files from Steam that discussion in the previous issue deemed unusual but valid, and Godot has parse errors when using Image.LoadJpgFromBuffer():

> E 0:02:00:173   NativeCalls.cs:6084 @ int Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_696(nint, nint, System.ReadOnlySpan`1[System.Byte]): Condition "err" is true. Returning: Ref<Image>()
  <C++ Source>  modules/jpg/image_loader_libjpeg_turbo.cpp:104 @ _jpeg_turbo_mem_loader_func()
  <Stack Trace> NativeCalls.cs:6084 @ int Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_696(nint, nint, System.ReadOnlySpan`1[System.Byte])
                Image.cs:1191 @ Godot.Error Godot.Image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(System.Byte[])

> E 0:02:00:173   NativeCalls.cs:6084 @ int Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_696(nint, nint, System.ReadOnlySpan`1[System.Byte]): Condition "image.is_null()" is true. Returning: ERR_PARSE_ERROR
  <C++ Source>  core/io/image.cpp:4193 @ _load_from_buffer()
  <Stack Trace> NativeCalls.cs:6084 @ int Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_696(nint, nint, System.ReadOnlySpan`1[System.Byte])
                Image.cs:1191 @ Godot.Error Godot.Image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(System.Byte[])


Here is a sample image, and I am happy to provide more on request:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/555950/capsule_184x69.jpg

This recent comment on the previous issue has alternate reproductive steps if needed:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/45523#issuecomment-3726981219

This recent comment on the previous issue indicates that the standalone version of the Godot jpg library can process these images correctly:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/45523#issuecomment-3727204761


Does Godot's version of the library need to be updated? Does its implementation within Godot need to be improved?

### Steps to reproduce

* Save the sample image from Steam
* Execute the below code:
```
var pathCapsuleImage = YourSavedSampleImagePathHere;
var fileAsByteArray = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(pathCapsuleImage);
var image = new Image();
var error = image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(fileAsByteArray);
if (!error.ToString().Equals("Ok"))
{
	GD.PushError(error.ToString() + " - Godot can't parse jpg at path: " + pathCapsuleImage);
	(Engine.GetMainLoop() as SceneTree).Quit();
}
```

N/A
